# WorthScope

> AI-powered career intelligence platform that helps young people discover careers, build personalized roadmaps, and complete guided missions with Koko, an AI mentor.

WorthScope guides users from a career assessment through a tailored roadmap of phases, missions, and skill-building activities. Koko, the built-in AI mentor, generates lessons, answers questions, and surfaces curated learning videos for each mission.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of WorthScope, how the assessment and roadmap work, and the value Koko brings to career discovery.
- [Sign in](/signin): Returning users sign in to access their dashboard, roadmap, and missions.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create an account to start the career assessment and unlock a personalized roadmap.
- [Career Assessment](/assessment): Multi-step assessment that scores interests, skills, and motivations to recommend matching careers.
- [Career Results](/career-results): Top recommended career paths from the assessment, with the option to choose a preferred path.
- [Career Roadmap](/roadmap): Personalized phase-by-phase roadmap toward the selected career, with missions to complete at each step.
- [Missions](/missions): Active learning missions with Koko-generated lessons and curated "Watch & Learn" videos.
- [Skill Progress](/skills): Weekly skill tracking, breakdown by competency, and suggested focus areas.
- [Career Opportunities](/career): Curated job and opportunity listings aligned with the user's chosen career path.

## Optional

- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Authenticated home for active users — greeting, current phase, missions, and progress.
- [Settings](/settings): Account, notification, and preference settings.
